intro: Lars is a beleaguered human survivor camping out in the wilderness of Duskwood. Along with his companion Sven Yorgen, he struggles to hold his ground on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank against the terrors that stalk the forest.

p: Perched in a modest camp on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank, Lars ekes out a precarious survival far from the questionable safety of Darkshire. Duskwood is treacherous at the best of times, but the surrounding woods crawl with ferocious beasts, relentless undead, and creeping worgen. Lars stays close by Sven Yorgen, striving simply to stay alive in an increasingly hostile wilderness.

Survival at the camp requires constant vigilance against the local predators. Lars finds himself sorely pressed by the relentless packs of starving dire wolves that haunt the shadows around their fire. Unable to lower his guard or drive them back alone, he relies on capable travelers to thin the hungry predators before his small camp is completely overrun.
